scripts.text:
[Representative]
Welcome to ^8B4513Luoyang^000000,
an ancient land with
a history full of tales
of bravery.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
歡迎來到^8B4513洛陽^000000，
這是一片古老的大地，
歷史上充滿了英勇的傳說。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
We now provide an ocean lane to accomodate foreign travelers and intercultural exchange from which all can benefit.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
我們現在提供海上航線，
以方便外國旅行者的往來和文化交流，
讓所有人都能從中受益。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
^8B4513Luoyang^000000 is famous for
its elaborate history, as well as specialties that are unique to this nation. Please take your time and enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
^8B4513洛陽^000000以其悠久的歷史以及該國獨有的特產而聞名。請慢慢遊覽，享受您的停留時光。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
The {0} is located at ^0A82FF+^000000. It is where all the nobles reside, including our lord.
Since you're an outsider, I guess it would be appropriate for you to visit our lord first.
{1}
scripts.translation:
[代表]
{0}位於^0A82FF+^000000。那裡是所有貴族居住的地方，包括我們的領主。
既然您是外來者，我想先去拜訪我們的領主會比較合適。
{1}

scripts.text:
[Representative]
We have a {0} where the federal government operates.
It is located at ^008080+^000000.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
我們有一個{0}，聯邦政府在那裡運作。
它位於^008080+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
If you have any problems,
you should talk with the
employees there.
{0}
scripts.translation:
[代表]
如果您有任何問題，
應該與那裡的員工交談。
{0}

scripts.text:
[Representative]
The {0} is located at ^55FF33+^000000.

[Representative]
You will see
marvelous weapons forged
by the well-experienced
Blacksmiths of Luoyang.
{0}
scripts.translation:
[代表]
您將看到由洛陽經驗豐富的鐵匠鍛造的
精美武器。
{0}

scripts.text:
[Representative]
The {0} is located at ^3355FF+^000000.

[Representative]
Knowing your enemy
is half the battle!
It's also safer to prepare yourself than to be sorry later. Why don't you go check their supplies?
{0}
scripts.translation:
[代表]
知己知彼，百戰不殆！
提前做好準備總比事後後悔要好。您不妨去看看他們的補給？
{0}

scripts.text:
[Representative]
When you get tired during your trip, I suggest that you visit the {0}. It's located at ^00FF00+^000000.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
當您在旅途中感到疲憊時，我建議您去{0}。它位於^00FF00+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
The Tavern is a good place
to meet other tourists, as well as to hear of any news that may be helpful to know.
{0}

[Representative]
You won't get a better view of the world than you can at the {0}.
It's a must see here.
{1}
scripts.translation:
[代表]
在{0}，您將看到比這裡更廣闊的世界景色。
這是必去之地。
{1}

scripts.text:
[Representative]
If you want to return to Alberta,
find the {0} outside town on the docks.
{1}

[代表]
如果您想返回艾爾貝塔，
請在鎮外的碼頭找到{0}。
{1}

scripts.text:
[Representative]
Enjoy your trip~!
